name: starts empty
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
assert tree.contains(10) is False
assert tree.in_order() == []

name: inserts and finds values
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
for value in [5, 3, 7, 1, 4]:
    tree.insert(value)
assert tree.contains(4) is True
assert tree.contains(6) is False

name: returns in-order values
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
for value in [5, 3, 7, 1, 4, 6, 8]:
    tree.insert(value)
assert tree.in_order() == [1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]

name: keeps duplicates
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
for value in [5, 3, 5, 3]:
    tree.insert(value)
assert tree.in_order() == [3, 3, 5, 5]

name: single element tree
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
tree.insert(42)
assert tree.contains(42) is True
assert tree.contains(41) is False
assert tree.in_order() == [42]

name: contains root after single insert
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
tree.insert(1)
assert tree.contains(1) is True

name: negative numbers
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
for value in [-5, -10, 0, -3, 5]:
    tree.insert(value)
assert tree.in_order() == [-10, -5, -3, 0, 5]
assert tree.contains(-3) is True
assert tree.contains(100) is False

name: large values
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
for value in [1000000, 0, -1000000, 999999, 1]:
    tree.insert(value)
assert tree.in_order() == [-1000000, 0, 1, 999999, 1000000]

name: all same value (degenerate)
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
for _ in range(10):
    tree.insert(7)
assert tree.contains(7) is True
assert tree.in_order() == [7] * 10

name: sorted sequence inserts (right-only degenerate)
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
for i in range(1, 11):
    tree.insert(i)
assert tree.in_order() == list(range(1, 11))
assert tree.contains(1) is True
assert tree.contains(10) is True
assert tree.contains(5) is True

name: reverse sorted sequence (left-only degenerate)
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
for i in range(10, 0, -1):
    tree.insert(i)
assert tree.in_order() == list(range(1, 11))
assert tree.contains(1) is True
assert tree.contains(10) is True

name: only left subtree
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
tree.insert(5)
tree.insert(3)
tree.insert(1)
assert tree.in_order() == [1, 3, 5]
assert tree.contains(5) is True
assert tree.contains(3) is True

name: only right subtree
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
tree.insert(1)
tree.insert(3)
tree.insert(5)
assert tree.in_order() == [1, 3, 5]
assert tree.contains(1) is True
assert tree.contains(5) is True

name: multiple inserts of same root value
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
tree.insert(10)
tree.insert(10)
tree.insert(10)
assert tree.contains(10) is True
assert tree.in_order() == [10, 10, 10]

name: contains on empty tree returns False
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
assert tree.contains(1) is False
assert tree.contains(-999) is False
assert tree.contains(999999) is False

name: large mixed insertion preserves order
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
data = [50, 25, 75, 12, 37, 62, 87, 6, 18, 30, 44, 56, 68, 80, 94, 3, 10, 20, 33, 40]
for x in data:
    tree.insert(x)
assert tree.in_order() == sorted(data)
assert tree.contains(50) is True
assert tree.contains(6) is True
assert tree.contains(94) is True

name: search every inserted node
code:
tree = BinarySearchTree()
data = [10, 5, 15, 3, 7, 12, 18]
for x in data:
    tree.insert(x)
assert not tree.contains(1) and not tree.contains(4) and not tree.contains(999)
for x in data:
    assert tree.contains(x) is True
